Black Police Officer Had Sex with Suspect Instead of Taking her to Jail - Gets Arrested [Freddie Fountain] [Macon GA]

No Cached Version

A former Macon police officer was sentenced to three years in prison Tuesday after he pleaded guilty to allegations he had sex with a shoplifting suspect in 2011 instead of taking her to jail.

Freddie Fountain, 28, said he was pleading guilty in his “best interest.”

His trial began Monday with jury selection in Bibb County Superior Court. Opening statements set to begin Tuesday morning were preempted by Fountain’s pleading guilty to sexual assault against a person in custody and violation of oath by a public officer.

After his release from prison, Fountain must serve seven years on probation and register as a sex offender.

Fountain and another officer responded to a report of two women shoplifting at Old Navy on Presidential Parkway Oct. 11, 2011.

The women were loaded into two patrol cars. One woman was taken to the Macon Mall precinct where she was cited for misdemeanor shoplifting, prosecutor Dorothy Hull said.

The other woman, the one in Fountain’s cruiser, was instead taken to an apartment on Mercer University Drive where she and Fountain had sex, she said.

The woman was under the influence of prescription pills and “wasn’t in her right mind,” Hull said.

After the encounter, Fountain drove the woman back to Presidential Parkway where she retrieved her car.

Later, when the woman cited for shoplifting threatened to subpoena her alleged accomplice to testify in her defense, the woman who allegedly had sex with Fountain reported her encounter with the officer to police.

Hull said the woman who had sex with Fountain has since moved out of the country and has been successful in fighting her addiction.

Fountain was arrested about four years ago and has been out of jail on bond awaiting trial.

He was taken into custody following Tuesday’s hearing.
